text.tspan: Competency Framework for Independent Standard Work
The framework defines the observable progression and evidence required before a new engineer can be approved for independent standard technical work.
Define what a learner must know, perform and demonstrate at increasing levels of support.
Explains the purpose, sequence and basic logic of standard work.
Does not prove reliable task performance.
Completes defined work with active direction and correction.
Routine decisions are confirmed by another person.
Not ready to work without active guidance.
Completes standard work with targeted clarification or review.
Support is episodic rather than continuous.
Repeatable independent performance is not yet established.
Completes standard work without routine supervision.
Support is requested only for justified exceptions.
Standard work only — not specialist authority.
